name: Coppy Tour
storyline: You are a helicopter pilot, trying to survive your way through the Coppy Tour 2D world, in hopes of achieving a feat no man has ever accomplished... Collecting 100% of all targets and coins, while looking cool..
summary:
Coppy Tour is a side-scrolling arcade adventure with the goal of collecting all coins, targets, and hidden items spread across the Coppy Tour 2D world. It is a classic "High-Score" competition, with an online leaderboard and unlimited playability. Control your player through the course to collect coins, while using your gun to collect targets. Hidden coins and pickups may require several playthroughs to find or access. With a run duration under 30-minutes, you can attempt to beat your high score frequently, though legend has it nobody has ever completed with 100% of the items collected.

Unlock new weapons, skins, item customizations, and map features through in game decisions. Learn the levels to maximize your score each run and find all unlockable items. In-depth stats menus keep track of your achievements, with runs saving automatically and several gameplay options to choose from.
